note: Simulated rooms, by tools/bank/generate.py's image method. A room is a box with one absorption for every wall; decay_ms in a manifest is read from the response the builder made, never stated here. A condition is a room, where the talker and the microphone stand, and the noise added. gain_at_1m_q15 is the size of the direct sound one metre from the talker, over 32768: 8192 puts a voice half a metre away at half of full scale. A noise's rms is in samples of 16-bit audio and decides the bytes; level_dbfs describes it and is held to within 0.05 dB of the rms.
